system.description:
The Abyssal invokes the uttermost principle of the Void — the hunger that predates the world and will outlast it — transforming her body into a living conduit for the devouring depths of Oblivion. Her form becomes half-real, her physical strikes carrying the essence of nothingness, and she can consume the essence of her opponents with each successful hit, draining a number of motes equal to the damage inflicted. Attacks made in this state deal aggravated damage and ignore all forms of magical protection less powerful than perfect defenses.

The transformation is overwhelming to witness: the Abyssal's body is wreathed in an anti-light that devours illumination, her features become those of an idealized void-avatar, and all within (Essence × 5) yards feel the pull of her shintai as a genuine physical force drawing them closer. She gains bonus dice equal to twice her Essence on all Martial Arts rolls while transformed. This is the pinnacle Shintai charm prerequisite for Song of the Depths.
